title: Fix connection publish flow
body: ## Summary - Import the shared Supabase client in `ConnectionCreatePage` so publishing can perform the insert. - Normalize connection visibility values before inserting into the `connections` table. - Treat Supabase insert errors as failed publishes instead of closing as if publish succeeded. - Wire the preview edit action back to step 2. ## Testing - `npx eslint src/components/connection-create/ConnectionCreatePage.jsx --quiet` ✅ - `npm run build` ✅ - `npm run lint` ⚠️ fails on existing repo-wide lint errors unrelated to this change (unused imports/parsing issues in other files).
